parts.html: The K-10 kitchen model combines the distinctive character of loft-style interiors with warm brown tones, wood-effect textures, and contemporary glass cabinetry.
Its L-shaped configuration creates a practical kitchen environment where contrasting materials, clean architectural lines, and functional storage work together.

The defining feature of this model is the combination of glass upper cabinet fronts and wood-effect lower cabinetry. Glass elements introduce visual lightness, while the brown laminated surfaces add warmth and natural character to the furniture composition.
This combination complements loft-inspired interiors featuring exposed brick, concrete finishes, metal details, natural wood, and neutral decorative materials.
The corner layout allows cooking, preparation, and storage areas to be arranged along two adjoining walls, making efficient use of the available kitchen space.
With a total linear length of 5.2 meters, the K-10 model provides practical cabinetry and integrated appliance placement without requiring a separate kitchen island.
The compact laminate countertop reinforces the clean architectural appearance of the kitchen and offers a practical surface for everyday food preparation.
The upper cabinet fronts are made of glass, while the lower cabinets feature laminated particleboard fronts. The main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
A pull-out cargo storage system provides convenient access to kitchen essentials and helps organize the available cabinet space.
For comfortable everyday operation, the model includes Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges and concealed Muller Profi Line drawer runners.
Furniture handles are included in the configuration.
K-10 Kitchen Specifications:
Style: Loft
Color: Brown
Configuration: L-shaped / corner kitchen
Linear length: 5.2 m
Dimensions: 5.2 × 2.7 × 0.6 m
Countertop: Compact laminate
Upper cabinet fronts: Glass
Lower cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard
Cabinet construction: 18 mm laminated particleboard
Appliances: Built-in
Lift mechanism: None
Hinges: Muller Profi Line soft-close
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
Handles: Included
Cargo storage: Yes
Kitchen island: No
Finish: Wood-effect decor
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-10 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-10 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a distinctive loft-inspired interior combining glass cabinetry, warm wood textures, and functional kitchen design.
